title: AiFailure
description: Why a model call didn't give an answer, classified so every app shows the same words and offers the same next step. Merges Ghosted's codex.ts classifier with AD Hub's AI-off and cap gate.

message.description: Safe to show: no tokens, no prompt or answer text.

retryAfterMs.description: When known (busy, limitReached, overCap): how long before trying again is worth it.

failureKind.title: AiFailureKind
failureKind.description: notSignedIn: no login for the provider. signInExpired: the login's refresh failed; sign in again. limitReached: the plan's usage window is used up. busy: the provider is overloaded (a fallback model may have been tried). offline: the network or provider couldn't be reached. timeout: the call took longer than allowed. badShape: the answer didn't match the schema, after the one retry. aiOff: AI is switched off for this app, feature or person. overCap: this app's own spending or call cap is reached. failed: the provider refused the request or failed in a way none of the others covers (a 400, an unknown model); retrying the same request won't help.
